summary: You can ask Nora where anyone who shares their location with her is — not only people who happen to be in the group you are asking from.
details: A friend who shares her location but is not a member of that particular group used to come back as «nobody here goes by that», which was untrue of somebody Nora knows perfectly well.
Who may ASK is unchanged and still narrow: only the people named for that room in the trust settings.
limitations: Who may be TOLD is also unchanged — the same room checks run in full before any name is looked up, so a room she is not allowed to disclose into still gets nothing.
Somebody present who does not share their location resolves by name and gets an honest «I have no recorded location for them», rather than being treated as a stranger.
